why: Nov 22 news reserve: no confirmed event from the last 48h in events.uncovered[] (the four intake items are a celebrity backlash, a prop exhibit dated Nov 19, a lipstick and a manicure trend). 11-19 already took the 1989 fallback, so per the calendar this takes standby pool #2; Michigan Senate was dropped because the subject is a sitting politician and the post could not stay clear of politics, so this is the calendar's named alternate (Taylor names her two albums of the year). critique.rationale: Feel first (Taylor being a fan of someone else's record), then the checkable detail off the Nov 13 moment record: LUX and The Art of Loving, named at a Golden Globe voters' press conference. The photo is a real credited shot of Taylor mid-interview, related in spirit, not from the event.
